items.t: Automatic transmission harsh shifts or failure
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $2,000 for a failed transmission. A valve body or fluid service costs far less if caught early.

items.t: Gas pedal sticks or the van lurches from a stop
items.job: Clean throttle body and inspect throttle cable
items.note: A new throttle body or cable costs more if cleaning does not fix it.

items.t: Distributor failure causes stalling or no-start
items.note: Includes cap, rotor and the built-in cam sensor on most replacement units.

items.t: Hot-weather stalling and long cranking
items.note: An engine computer update may also be needed.

items.t: Fuel injector failure causes rough running
items.note: One injector costs less, but they are usually replaced as a set.

items.t: Check engine light from knock sensor code
items.note: Most of the cost is labor to remove the intake manifold.

items.t: EGR system faults set a check engine light
items.job: Clean EGR passages or replace EGR valve

items.t: Power door locks lock and unlock on their own
items.job: Replace door lock actuator or switch (one door)

items.t: Fuel line connector hoses can crack and leak (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace fuel connector hoses
items.note: Free under recall 96V-203 if not already done.

items.t: Fuel tank vent hose can crack and leak (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 00V-419 if not already done.

items.t: Battery post can leak acid (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 97V-184 if not already done.

items.t: Power windows work after the key is off (recall)
Tail light bulb can fall out of its socket (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 99V-347 if not already done.

items.t: Seat belt buckle bases may be weak (recall)
Steering gear mounting bolts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten steering gear bolts

items.t: Front seat belt buckle bolt can loosen (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front seat belt buckle
items.note: Free under recall 00V-338 if not already done.

items.t: Front brakes vibrate and wear quickly
items.note: Add about $65–150 per side if a caliper is sticking.

items.t: ABS warning light comes on at highway speed
items.note: An ABS actuator, if that is the cause, costs several hundred dollars more.

items.t: Rear drum brakes grind, squeal or bind
items.job: Rear brake shoes, hardware and drums

items.t: Brake light switch fault stops the shifter leaving Park
items.note: An owner reported about $70 for the switch from a parts dealer.

items.t: Rear A/C lines under the van leak
items.job: Replace rear underbody A/C line section and recharge

items.t: A/C blows warm in hot weather
items.job: A/C leak test, repair and recharge
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $500; a new compressor is at the high end.

items.t: Musty smell from the vents
items.job: Clean A/C evaporator and clear drain

items.t: Coolant leaks from hoses or cylinder head gasket
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $800 when hard-to-reach hoses and gaskets were done together. A head gasket job costs much more.

items.t: Valve cover gasket oil leaks
items.note: The rear cover needs the intake plenum removed.

items.t: Radiator fan fails or its connector melts
items.job: Replace radiator fan motor and connector

items.t: Broken engine mounts cause clunking
Headlights flicker or the connector melts
items.job: Replace headlight connector pigtail and bulb

items.t: Wipers run with the switch off
Sliding door sticks or is hard to close
items.job: Service sliding door rollers and track

items.t: Front stabilizer bar bushings and links wear
items.job: Replace front stabilizer bushings and links
